Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for DRDO MTRDC Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application mode is a walk-in interview. Candidates should attend the walk-in interview on 15 October 2026. There is no separate application deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Junior Research Fellow posts at DRDO MTRDC?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies announced for the Junior Research Fellow position at Microwave Tube Research & Development Centre (DRDO MTRDC).

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary for Junior Research Fellow at DRDO MTRDC?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Junior Research Fellow post will receive a salary of Rs. 37,000/- per month along with House Rent Allowance as per rules.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Junior Research Fellow post is 28 years. Age relaxation is applicable for SC/ST/PH (5 years) and OBC (3 years) candidates.

faq.question: Q5. What are the essential qualifications for DRDO MTRDC JRF recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Graduate Degree (B.E/B.Tech) in Electronics/EI/ECE/ET/EEE with NET/GATE, OR an M.Sc. in Electronics with NET, OR an M.E./M.Tech in Electronics/Power Electronics/Electrical Engineering.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for DRDO MTRDC Junior Research Fellow?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Junior Research Fellow position at DRDO MTRDC is based on a Walk-in Interview.

faq.question: Q7. Where is the job location for the DRDO MTRDC Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: The job location for the Junior Research Fellow position is Bengaluru, Karnataka, with pincode 560013.

faq.question: Q8. How can I apply for the DRDO MTRDC Junior Research Fellow walk-in?
faq.answer: Candidates must attend the walk-in interview on the specified date with their Bio-Data, original certificates, copies, and a recent passport-size photo. Refer to the "How to Apply" section for detailed instructions.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for the DRDO MTRDC Junior Research Fellow recruitment.

faq.question: Q10. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates should bring original certificates, one set of self-attested photocopies of all academic and experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs.
